Hi Mira —

Appreciate the pilot data — looks healthy. High level, two pragmatic paths we recommend depending on how fast you want committed throughput: 

1) Direct Tier Upgrade (fast, single contract):
   - Sign a 12-month Reserved Capacity agreement at the target throughput tier.
   - Typical commercial uplift: 15–30% discount off list depending on commit.
   - Benefits: predictable latency SLA, single billing, priority routing.

2) Step-up Conversion (gradual, lower initial commitment):
   - Convert pilot credits to a 3–6 month reserved bridge with an option to convert to 12-month at a pre-agreed rate.
   - We commonly apply a conversion credit (one-time) equal to 20% of pilot spend toward the first reserved invoice.
   - Benefits: lower near-term commitment, preserves ability to prove ops at scale.

Regarding hybrid hosting: yes — we support mixed routing. You can pin PHI traffic to a Dedicated pool in your VPC while keeping non-sensitive burst on Hosted. We’ll include a network/ingress plan in the MPA and a short appendix for data residency.

Downgrade/rollback: standard downgrade window is 30 days after a tier change; for annual contracts we include a one-time 60‑day safety window for early-year adjustments on commercial approval.

To keep things concrete, I’ve attached a draft MPA for a 12-month reserved conversion and a short commercial summary. If you’re open, we can offer a 30% pilot-conversion discount if you commit to dedicated capacity and a 12-month term (requires account executive approval).

Next steps:
- Confirm preferred path (1 vs 2) and expected steady-state QPS.
- If path 1, we’ll send a redline-ready MPA and a DocuSign link.
- If path 2, we’ll build a bridge invoice and credit note.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-44921
Attached: Draft_MPA_20260923.pdf

Thanks — cc’ing Lauren and Ben to align on feature bundling and commercial concessions.

—Ethan
Ethan Park\Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Quick product/ops notes to attach to the proposal:

- Feature bundling suggestions for Clarify Health (recommended default package):
  • Core inference (text generation + chat)
  • Audit logs (30-day retention, optional 12m add-on)
  • Enhanced observability (per-route latency & token breakdown)
  • KV cache persistence (customer-scoped cache on Dedicated)

- Downgrade guardrails: implement a 30-day rollback window after any tier change; for customers that convert mid-quarter we allow one pro-rated adjustment during the first 90 days.

I’ll prepare a short appendix for the MPA describing how features map to entitlements and the default fallback policy when Dedicated capacity is unavailable.
